verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents that you can configure the equation that calculates customers' risk scores (docs-2), and cases can be filtered by customer risk (docs-6). That covers the configuration half of the story. Nothing documents a view or explanation of why a customer's risk score changed. The case audit trail records case activity, not risk-score changes, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented per-factor risk configuration detail, a risk-score change history or explanation for a customer, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
